_about: Round 11 (2026-11-25): the sharp change at 0:04 (Anthony: ':04 had a sharp transition'). Measured: the 3-second opening section is about 10 dB quieter than what follows. Earlier rounds are in variants_round*.json. Also: exact-moment effects were getting buried (Anthony: 'we missed the cable shooting out from his arm'; it was planned at 16.65 s but mixed 8 dB down under the vacuum).

variants.label: No very short sections
variants.why: The three-second opening was its own very quiet section, then the music jumped. Sections under five seconds are now folded into the next one.

variants.label: Changes land on the music's bar lines
variants.why: The music changes on its own strong beat nearest the cut, instead of exactly on the cut, so the change sounds intended.

variants.label: No short sections, changes on bar lines
Both, with the volume gently evened out
variants.why: Both of the above, and quiet and loud stretches of the music are pulled a little closer together.

variants.label: Key moment effects louder
variants.why: The exact-moment effects (the cable firing, the hook, the snaps) were mixed well below the background effects. Here they are 8 dB louder. Music is unchanged from Current.

variants.label: Key moment effects louder, background makes room
variants.why: As above, and the background effects such as the vacuum roar drop briefly under each key moment so it cuts through. Music is unchanged from Current.
